text:
maria-marketing: Quick prelaunch check 680 Need keywords + JSON-LD + internal anchors + redirects for the webinar landing. Can marketing + SEO sign off today?

leo-seo: I'll deliver a funneled KW list (intent | mid | product) and suggested H1/H2 placements. Top seeds: "inference cost", "production latency", "dedicated inference".

tasha-growth: We want to A/B CTAs: Variant A = "See benchmark results" (benchmark narrative) Variant B = "Get early access" (product funnel). Separate UTMs + thank-you pages.

omar-analytics: Event spec: `webinar_signup` with labels `cta_variant` and `kw_group`. Test plan: submit form with variant A/B and verify event in GA debug view and server-side logs. I'll drop a short checklist in the sheet.

viv-ops: Slug constraints: ASCII-only, hyphens, <=64 chars. Redirects: prefer 301 except for temporary promos. Please add redirect CSV to the PR for CI check.

leo-seo: Draft redirect rows to append to redirects.csv:
```
/old-inference-blog,/webinar/production-inference,301,intent=benchmark
/beta-signup,/webinar/prod-inference,301,intent=signup
/seed-post,/webinar/seed-kw,302,intent=kw-capture
```
I'll add an `intent` column so marketing can filter campaign redirects.

maria-marketing: Action items:
- @leo-seo: KW list + JSON-LD (Event, FAQ 3 Qs, Breadcrumb)
- @tasha-growth: CTA copy + UTM mapping + thank-you drafts
- @omar-analytics: event test plan + simulated CTRs in sheet
- @viv-ops: open PR with redirects.csv + CI slug lint
I'll assemble the internal anchor map (3 anchors: product, docs quickstart, webinar) and final microcopy. Mark done in the sheet when complete.

deploy-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/prod-inference-preview (build 2023-11-02-14)

maria-marketing: Perfect. Once SEO + Analytics confirm, we'll promote to prod tomorrow morning and run a final redirect sweep. :rocket:
